**Summary**

We cannot complete review of this ICD authorization without additional documentation. Two of four clinical criteria are met; one is missing.

**Criteria Status**

✓ **ICD Indication – MET**  
Non-ischemic dilated cardiomyopathy with LVEF 35% (biplane Simpson, 2/18/2025) and NYHA class II heart failure (documented 3/13/2025).

✓ **Optimal Medical Therapy – MET**  
Patient on sacubitril/valsartan (started 3/8/2024), carvedilol (started 3/10/2024), and spironolactone (started 3/18/2024)—exceeding the required 90-day duration.

✓ **Exclusions – MET**  
No NYHA class IV, cardiogenic shock, recent MI, or recent revascularization documented.

✗ **Shared Decision-Making – MISSING**  
The record lacks documentation of a formal shared decision-making encounter using an evidence-based decision tool prior to the ICD order. The 3/13/2025 cardiology note does not document such discussion.

**Required Information**

Please submit documentation of a shared decision-making encounter that includes discussion of ICD therapy options and use of an evidence-based decision-making tool completed before or on the order date.
